excluded.reason: GetThisDrv reserves error 26 for an in-use non-FAT/IFS CDS with a device pointer; no shipped operational IFS filesystem can supply an OPEN path, while invalid FAT media is returned as a drive or critical-device error
$Dup2 closes and reuses the caller-selected JFT slot and has no allocation path; its live failure exits come only from handle validation, despite the broader historical allowed-error row
$CURRENT_DIR can receive error 26 only from GetThisDrv's in-use non-FAT/IFS CDS case; no shipped operational IFS filesystem provides such a current directory
$DEALLOC maps every failed MCB signature check directly to error_invalid_block; it has no live return of error_arena_trashed
$SETBLOCK sends every failed MCB signature or coalescing check to alloc_trashed (error 7), and capacity failure to error 8; no live error_invalid_block path exists
The local extended-attribute implementation is a stub; its insufficient-space error_not_enough_memory assignment and carry-set path are commented out
Live local file-time selectors 2 through 4 either return stub EA data or success and contain no invalid-data return; remote behavior requires an external redirector
Extended-open EA parameter processing and post-open EA setting are commented out, including the only local path that could propagate EA memory exhaustion
The path resolver's error 26 case requires an operational non-FAT/IFS CDS; no shipped IFS implementation supplies extended-open file operations
The GetIOParms parser and every live transfer to ext_inval_parm are commented out, leaving no local extended-open invalid-data return
Local DOS_MKDIR can receive MakeNode error 7 only when the unrelated extended-open flag is active; MKDIR never sets that flag, leaving file-not-found to redirector behavior
Local DOS_RMDIR explicitly maps every GetPath miss to error_path_not_found and every non-directory target to access denied; only the redirector can return file not found
Local DOS_CHDIR overwrites every GetPath failure with error_path_not_found and has no live file-not-found return; the broader allowance is for redirector behavior
Local $FIND_FIRST documents and implements only path-not-found during translation and no-more-files after search; no file-not-found branch exists
$CreateTempFile generates a concrete eight-hex-digit leaf before calling create-new; the MakeNode file-not-found branch requires extended-open state that create-temporary never establishes

$GSetMediaID only validates its get/set selector, and the shipped BIOS GetMediaID/SetMediaID routines never inspect the packet information-level field; invalid-data is reserved for another device implementation
